aeon_extension: minimize the exact number of trainable parameters (Pareto objective)
differences: This is a grammar-based Aeon synthesis benchmark, not a replication of the upstream genetic algorithm or paper results.
Upstream runtime random initialization overwrites several grammar parameters and inserts optional batch normalization; Aeon follows the grammar, not those overwrites.
Upstream train.py fixes SGD(lr=0.001,momentum=0.9) and uses one epoch on a training tenth during search; Aeon honors the chosen optimizer and uses all supplied training data.
Grammar decay maps to PyTorch weight_decay; upstream training does not interpret this grammar field.
Beta1/beta2/rho exclude the endpoint 1 required for valid PyTorch optimizer coefficients.
The amsgrad production is unreachable from learning and is deliberately not a building block.
Same padding has ceiling output dimensions for all grammar strides, including asymmetric even kernels; average pooling includes explicit zero padding in its denominator.
Early stopping maximizes observed validation accuracy; loss is negative log likelihood of the softmax output rather than cross entropy applied to already normalized probabilities.
A seed-42 split is used for both datasets; upstream CIFAR-10 split is unseeded.
Default evaluation is a one-epoch pilot; --epochs 400 enables the grammar epoch cap. The smoke fixture is synthetic, not an MNIST/CIFAR result.
